topic: student-led protests over education costs, university conditions and jobs, escalating to anti-government demands for Rama resignation
scale: tens of thousands of students in Tirana (Guardian, Oct 14); 23 taken in for questioning, six police and a journalist injured (Tirana Times, Oct 13)
quote1: The unrest began outside the Ministry of Education, where students and other young demonstrators gathered to express dissatisfaction with university conditions, limited employment prospects and the continuing departure of young Albanians seeking opportunities abroad.
quote2: “This is a revolution. We are tired of peaceful protests. We will not stop until Rama resigns,” said Lora, a student who declined to give her last name as she threw rocks at the police.
